outcome: Breastfeeding initiation within 1 hour of birth
cohort: 16,400 women admitted in labor to the maternity ward of Dar Al-Shifa Hospital, Gaza City, from September 1, 2015 to June 30, 2018
finding: Implementation of the WHO's Safe Childbirth Project at Dar Al-Shifa Hospital in Gaza City improved most indicators of quality of care, including risk assessment on admission, use of partograms, deliveries by midwife, breastfeeding initiation within 1 hour of birth, and number of postnatal examinations.
mod_finding: Deliveries by midwife for low-risk women increased from 53% to 100% after the implementation of the Safe Childbirth Project.
